name: Create a workflow using a saved integration
query: Help me create a workflow to trigger a Lambda. Use Ohio, wait for the response and accept the ARN and payload as workflow inputs. The selected cluster has one eligible saved Lambda connection, finance-test.
expected_behavior: Discovers the advertised invocation and inspects its saved-connection schema.
success_criteria: Discovers the advertised invocation and inspects its saved-connection schema.
The first saved-connection list command uses conductor integration list --type with the discovered Lambda type ID and succeeds without retrying with different flags.
Uses the sole eligible finance-test connection without asking reuse versus create, and drafts an INTEGRATION invocation with region us-east-2 and runtime inputs.
Registers and verifies a workflow definition and provides an editor link or relative path, without cloud calls, execution, or trigger activation.
